notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed UI misalignment in ultrawide resolutions, including incorrect positioning and overlapping elements.

[strike]Investigating an issue where some players cannot access the game due to a Steam connection error. This is related to the Steam Client Beta; opting out of the beta is a temporary workaround while we work on a permanent fix.[/strike]
This issue has been resolved by Valve in the latest Steam Client Beta update:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/4397053/view/605276452911318951?l=english

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.content:
As we prepare for the full release later this month, here’s a summary of the updates and improvements made in this final demo patch.

[h3]Update notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorials are now hidden by default, and can be toggled manually while playing[/b]
[*] [b]Control prompts are now displayed directly in the UI during gameplay, instead of being limited to the pause menu[/b]
[*] [b]Improved camera zooming behaviour, and increased limits for minimum and maximum zoom levels[/b]
[*] [b]Complete audio overhaul:[/b] Added 4 original music tracks and completely redone all sound effects in the game
[*] [b]Level adjustments and balancing:[/b] Tweaked numerous levels, with rebalanced time and rotation limits
[*] [b]Various bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements[/b]
[/list]

While completing this final demo update, we’ve also been hard at work on the full game, which includes 40+ additional levels not featured in the demo, as well as new mechanics and challenges.

The full game is scheduled to launch on [b]January 31st, 2025.[/b]

For bug reports and feedback, please visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3342810/discussions/0/4635988976587591525/]pinned discussion thread[/url].

notes.title: Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Based on the feedback we received during the first week of the demo, here are the changes and fixes we've implemented:

[h3]Update notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Reduced level load animation time[/b]
[*] [b]Improved camera movement for keyboard and gamepad users:[/b] The camera will now move only when necessary
[*] [b]Adjusted levels and chapter structure:[/b] Several redundant levels were removed, and remaining levels were rearranged and rebalanced. As a result, the demo now only includes 20 levels (2 chapters) instead of 30, and progression should feel less repetitive
[*] [b]Various minor bug fixes and patches[/b]
[/list]

[b]Important:[/b] Due to the changes in the level structure, save data from previous versions of the demo is no longer compatible.

For bug reports and feedback, please visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3342810/discussions/0/4635988976587591525/]pinned discussion thread[/url].
